description: Queue video library entries for one or more social accounts. The timer (every 5 min) uploads and prepares them; they are published only by an approved plan (schedule_social_publishing). Already queued or posted entries are skipped per account.

language.description: default: the account's language, else de

library_slug.description: Slug of the video library entry

text.description: post text; default: summary + link to the video page

title.description: title (Pinterest, LinkedIn video title); default: library title

name: queue_social_posts
